2, This is the default sorting order in the Godot documentation system. C# has not been sorted in this way, and the gds will also automatically sort in this way. So I will not deal with this for now
1 and 3 should be fine now.

@dtaralla 

All three issues are fixed:

**1.** Fixed.

**2.** Fixed, but it requires an extra change to a CPP file, which makes this PR much harder to merge (since it's required to not modify CPP outside of C#) — but I couldn't avoid modifying CPP for this one.

**3.** Fixed. The brief description uses the `<summary>` alone, while the description uses the full content.

I didn't squash the commits, so everyone can see exactly what each change does. Feel free to test the updated branch
